## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Safety impact

- Affected SC / EV / SAF IDs (or explain why none apply):
- Changes to assumptions, observation quality, authority, data mutation or recovery:
- Evidence review note updated for every affected control:
- Verification performed: tested commit, commands / CI run, results (including skips):
- Residual risk and any controls left unverified or stale:

Reviewers: check the production call path, bypasses, failure behavior and
whether the evidence supports the bounded claim. A green bookkeeping check
does not certify safety. See [the evidence workflow](../docs/SAFETY-TODO.md).
